records.text: An anonymous source reported that George Zinn went to Utah Valley Hospital after the event and told people he had been told and paid to take the blame, although he did not know where the payment came from.
records.speaker: George Zinn hospital/payment source (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: I told you guys that we had a source leaked to us. He went to the hospital. ... He went to Utah Valley Hospital after this event to treat some of his like mild injuries from being dragged. ... And he told people that he was told to do it, and he was paid to do it. ... But he didn't know where the payment was coming from.

verification.notes: The episode confirms Owens repeated an allegation attributed only to an anonymous source. Live searches found no attributable witness, hospital record, payment record, or reliable independent report corroborating that George Zinn said he had been paid or instructed to take blame. Absence of corroboration is not proof the allegation is false, so it is resolved as attempted/unverifiable.
